question: What ultimate attainment becomes immediately accessible to the accomplished practitioner?
premises: Nothing is unattainable for that practitioner in this world
Liberation is said to be situated in his hand
The statement is addressed to the goddess
inference: For such a practitioner, liberation is immediately at hand and nothing is unattainable.
plain_english: O goddess, nothing is unattainable for him in this world; liberation is situated in his hand.
